cards.title: Commits stay on their branch
cards.body: A commit on a branch exists only there until you merge it, so `main` stays exactly as it was. Watch `header.html` disappear when we switch back.
cards.code:
git init
touch index.html
git add .
git commit -m "Start"
git switch -c header
touch header.html
git add .
git commit -m "Add header"
git switch main
ls

hi.title: Commits apni branch par rehte hain
hi.body: Branch par kiya commit merge hone tak sirf wahin rehta hai, isliye `main` bilkul waisa hi rehta hai. Wapas switch karne par `header.html` ko gayab hote dekho.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: `menu.html` should be committed on the `menu` branch, but it lands on `main`. Tap the bug.
cards.code:
git init
touch index.html
git add .
git commit -m "Start"
git branch menu
touch menu.html
git add .
git commit -m "Add menu"

bug.fix: `git branch menu` only creates the branch; you stay on `main`. `git switch -c menu` creates it and moves you there.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: `menu.html` `menu` branch par commit honi chahiye, par woh `main` par pahunch jaati hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: `git branch menu` sirf branch banata hai; aap `main` par hi rehte ho. `git switch -c menu` use banata hai aur aapko wahan le jaata hai.

check.question: You commit header.html on the `header` branch, then `git switch main`. Is header.html there?
options: No, it lives on the header branch
check.explanation: Each branch has its own commits. Switch back to `header` and the file returns.

hi.question: Aap `header` branch par header.html commit karte ho, phir `git switch main` karte ho. Kya header.html wahan hai?
options: Nahi, woh header branch par rehti hai
Haan, har branch ko milti hai
Woh hamesha ke liye delete ho jaati hai
hi.explanation: Har branch ke apne commits hote hain. Wapas `header` par switch karo aur file laut aati hai.

exercise.prompt: Create a branch `header`, add a file `header.html` on it, and commit it with the message `Add header`. Leave `main` without it.
exercise.promptHi: `header` branch banao, us par `header.html` file jodo, aur use message `Add header` ke saath commit karo. `main` ko uske bina chhodo.

checks.label: A commit on `header` says `Add header`
checks.labelHi: `header` par ek commit `Add header` kehta hai
